name: NJ Master Sewer and Plumbing
what_they_do: Sewer, drain and plumbing contractor handling residential and commercial plumbing, sewer and drain cleaning, water heaters, leak detection, fixture installation and 24-hour emergency repairs. Runs a free-estimate offer and a single-page Wix site with an embedded contact form and Google review feed.
customers: Homeowners plus commercial property managers and facilities needing drain/sewer work in North Brunswick and surrounding Middlesex County

size_signals.signal: Single-page Wix site with one phone number and a 'our experienced team' claim; no staff page, no years in business stated
55 Google reviews at 5.0 with owner-uploaded job photos 26 days ago - active owner-run operation, likely small crew
Google profile includes a full service list (emergency repairs, water heaters, commercial plumbing, sewer & drain, leak detection, fixtures)

website_review.primary_cta: 'Get a Free Estimate' with a contact form in the hero; phone is a click-to-call in the desktop nav
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Wix contact form (first name, last name, phone, email, subject, message) - a message drop, not a booking calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Google review feed with named reviewers, owner-uploaded job photos on Google, 5.0 rating, service list and FAQ section
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright reads 2024; no meta description; empty h1 elements; the page paints a blank white hero for ~6 seconds on a phone connection before content appears
website_review.search_basics: Title is only 'Home | NJ Master Sewer and Plumbing' - no service or town; no meta description; everything sits on one page with hash anchors so there are no individual service pages
top_issues: Single-page site with no service pages and a generic title - weak for searches like 'sewer cleaning North Brunswick'
No phone number visible on the phone layout above the fold (only the form and hamburger menu)
Copyright 2024, no meta description, empty h1s, and a multi-second blank render on mobile

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: claimed-looking, well-maintained profile - Plumber category, 5.0/55 reviews, 'Open 24 hours' with an expandable hours panel, owner photos from 26 days ago. robots.txt is Wix default and allows all agents (only PetalBot blocked, AhrefsBot crawl-delay). Answerable: services, service area and emergency availability are real text, but there is no hours listing on the site, no price ranges, and the two JSON-LD blocks are WebSite + ImageObjects only - no LocalBusiness with address or hours. Bookable: a labelled Wix form with no CAPTCHA, but nothing that books a slot; an agent would have to submit a message and wait.

operations_signals.signal: 24-hour emergency plumbing advertised, typically meaning the owner answers the phone at night - no chat, no answering service visible
One-page site funnels every enquiry into one generic form with no job-type routing, so intake triage is manual
Owner uploads job photos to Google regularly (photos 26 days ago) - marketing effort is manual and personal

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build out service pages (sewer & drain cleaning, water heaters, emergency plumbing) with town-targeted titles and LocalBusiness schema
top_opportunities.evidence: Site is one page titled 'Home | ...' with hash anchors only and no meta description; JSON-LD has no LocalBusiness

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add after-hours intake (missed-call text-back plus a short triage form) so 24/7 emergency leads are not lost
top_opportunities.evidence: 24-hour emergency service advertised with only a phone number and a single generic web form

top_opportunities.opportunity: Put a tappable phone number and a review-request automation in place
top_opportunities.evidence: Phone is not visible above the fold on the phone layout; 55 reviews at 5.0 show demand for review capture already exists

scores.reasons: A young, small but very well-reviewed shop with a thin one-page site - real gaps but limited budget; fixes are quick and standard; observed directly on site and Maps.
